config_files.notes: Primary graphics, resolution, and post-processing configuration. Edits made directly in the Steam install folder will be ignored or overwritten — always edit in the My Games user documents directory (including OneDrive-redirected paths such as O:\OneDrive\Documents\). If settings reset after starting the game, set the file to Read-Only.
User-level input bindings and mouse control settings.
Global engine input defaults for disabling mouse smoothing and mouse acceleration.

keys.notes: Set to 5120 for native 32:9 rendering on Dual QHD (5120x1440) displays.
Matches vertical pixel height for 1440p and DQHD monitors.

keys.effect: Camera focal depth-of-field blur during dialogue, exploration, and combat.
keys.notes: Eye Comfort priority: Disabling DoF eliminates constant optical refocusing strain across a wide 5120x1440 screen and restores sharp character and environmental clarity.

keys.effect: Radial screen blur triggered by sprinting, rolling, or taking heavy hits.
keys.notes: Eye Comfort / Motion Comfort priority: Primary trigger for visual vertigo and nausea, especially on 32:9 where radial distortion stretches severely across peripheral vision.
Eye Comfort priority: Disabling motion blur prevents smearing and ghosting across the 5120-pixel wide panoramic view.

keys.effect: Retains motion blur buffer when paused or during menu transitions.
Lionhead HDR bloom and intense atmospheric light scattering.
keys.notes: Eye Comfort priority: Fable Anniversary features notoriously harsh and blinding bloom lighting. Disabling or muting bloom relieves prolonged retinal fatigue.

keys.effect: Specular highlight bloom flares on metallic and reflective surfaces.

keys.notes: In-game VSync in Fable Anniversary causes severe micro-stuttering and irregular frame pacing. Always disable here and enforce frame rate limiting (60 FPS floor or monitor refresh rate) via GPU driver (NVIDIA Control Panel / AMD Adrenalin) or RTSS.
Prevents oblique surface blur on distant roads and terrain across ultra-wide angles. Low performance cost on modern GPUs.
2048 provides crisp dynamic character and world shadows without edge pixelation.
High quality anti-aliasing without temporal blur or motion smear.

keys.effect: Real-time point, spot, and directional lights.
Real-time shadow casting from dynamic entities.
Mouse input averaging and smoothing filter.
keys.notes: Disabling mouse smoothing ensures 1:1 raw mouse tracking and prevents camera float, reducing motion sickness.

keys.effect: Variable camera acceleration based on mouse movement speed.
keys.notes: Disables non-linear camera acceleration for consistent aim and tracking.

engine_overrides.behaviour: UE3 natively implements Vert- cropping on aspect ratios wider than 16:9, severely truncating vertical visibility at 32:9 (5120x1440) and stretching HUD elements to the extreme physical edges.
engine_overrides.action: Use Flawless Widescreen with the Fable Anniversary plugin. Enable FOV Fix and set 'HUD Constrained' to 21:9 (or 16:9) to center the interface within natural eye gaze.

engine_overrides.behaviour: In-engine VSync introduces severe frame pacing judder and stutter.
engine_overrides.action: Set UseVsync=False in INI and lock frame rate via GPU driver or RTSS.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Enable 'FOV Fix', enable 'Fix Letterbox', and configure 'HUD Constrained' to 21:9 (or 16:9)
manual_only_settings.reason: Restores Hor+ field of view at 5120x1440 and clamps HUD elements within comfortable central vision, eliminating neck strain and edge distortion.

manual_only_settings.location: NVIDIA Control Panel / AMD Software / RTSS
manual_only_settings.recommendation: Cap frame rate to monitor refresh rate (or 60/120 FPS)
manual_only_settings.reason: Ensures smooth 60FPS+ frame pacing without in-engine VSync micro-stutter.

manual_only_settings.location: Nexus Mods (Fable Anniversary 60 FPS Menu Mod)
manual_only_settings.reason: Fable Anniversary menus natively run in Flash capped at 30 FPS. The community mod unlocks menus to 60 FPS.
